subject: Octave Health renewal & expansion — term shift + order form redlines
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@octavehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@octavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Octave renewal proposal: 24mo term + capacity uplift (draft attached)

Samantha / Marcus —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call I attached a clean copy of the proposed MSA (Octave_MSA_v3.docx) and the updated order form showing the Q4 capacity uplift (OrderForm_Q4_2028.pdf). Key points in the package: 

- Term: we propose a 24-month renewal (Oct 1, 2028 — Sep 30, 2030) to align with your product roadmap.
- Capacity: 3x seat uplift for embeddings throughput starting 2028-11-01, with staged billing in the attached order form.
- Pricing: uplift at the committed reserved rate (line-item on OrderForm).
- SLA credits: unchanged from current MSA (standard 10% cap per incident).
- Data residency: we’ve called out US-only residency across the MSA as requested.

If you can ask legal to mark up the attached MSA, happy to review and converge. We can also run a short 30-minute call this week to walk through the redlines.

Next steps I recommend: legal redline -> Redwood legal review -> updated doc -> DocuSign execution.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Octave_MSA_v3.docx (draft), OrderForm_Q4_2028.pdf (proposed pricing)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@octavehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@octavehealth.com>, procurement@octavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Octave renewal proposal: 24mo term + capacity uplift (draft attached)

Naomi —

Thanks for the package and the clear summary. Our legal team reviewed and attached a redline (Octave_MSA_redlines_v3.docx) with the following high-level asks: 

1) Term: we prefer a 36-month term to preserve current amortization timing; if Redwood needs 24 months, we’ll ask for a termination-for-convenience clause with 90-day notice and pro-rated refund for unused reserved capacity.
2) Indemnity & IP: tighten the mutual indemnity carveouts and add a limited-liability exception for third-party model outputs.
3) Data residency and backup: we need stronger contractual language on proof of US-only residency and backups; can you confirm SOC 2 scope includes the new dedicated nodes?
4) Billing / PO path: procurement requests a PO process and net-60 invoice terms for the first year as part of the deal.

We can redline in-track changes but want to avoid lengthy back-and-forth. Can you loop in legal and finance so we can resolve the Term and billing items quickly?

Appreciate it —
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships
Octave Health
Samantha.Lee@octavehealth.com

Attachment: Octave_MSA_redlines_v3.docx (track changes from Octave legal)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@octavehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@octavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Oct 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Octave renewal proposal: 24mo term + capacity uplift (draft attached)

Samantha —

Appreciate the quick review and the clear asks. Looping in Logan (legal) and Kimberly (finance/procurement support) to triage. Quick responses to the bullets so we can prioritize redlines: 

1) Term: We can be flexible. Two possible paths:
   a) Redwood accepts a 36-month term at a ~3% price uplift to match amortization (we can provide a new order form), or
   b) Octave takes 24 months with a 90-day termination-for-convenience (T4C) and pro-rata refund for committed capacity — Redwood prefers the T4C route for operational predictability.

2) Indemnity & IP: We generally accept limited carveouts but will push back on indemnity tied to customer prompts that intentionally breach law. Logan, will share suggested language below.

3) Data residency: Redwood’s US-only residency is enforced for the dedicated pool; SOC 2 scope includes the serving runtime but we'll confirm the dedicated nodes in writing.

4) Billing / PO: Kimberly — can you confirm if we can accept net-60 for year 1 and provide a PO path? If not, what is the compromise?

Proposed next step: legal-to-legal sync (30 minutes) to close Term and Indemnity, then finance to finalize billing cadence and PO path. I’ll prepare a short summary for the call.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call tomorrow morning PST.

—
Naomi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Renewal_Summary_Octave_Q4.pdf (one-pager proposal)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@octavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@octavehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Octave renewal proposal: legal redline guidance

Naomi / Samantha —

I reviewed Octave's redline. High-level legal position and suggested language below (keeping things concise so procurement can route quickly):

- Term: If Octave requires 36 months, include a price uplift of +3.25% and maintain current SLA credit cap. If Octave prefers 24 months with T4C, add: "Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice; upon such termination Redwood will refund, pro rata, any prepaid, unused portion of committed reserved capacity fees."

- Indemnity: We can narrow indemnity for model outputs by adding: "Except as otherwise expressly provided, neither party shall be liable for third-party claims arising solely from Customer prompts or modifications to the model that materially deviate from Redwood's instructions or recommended usage."

- Data residency: Add a warranty clause and operational proof point: "Redwood warrants that Customer data associated with Customer's dedicated pool will be stored and processed in data centers located in the United States. Evidence of residency (system logs and node inventory snapshot) will be provided within seven (7) business days of Customer request.)"

- Billing / PO: Redwood legal is comfortable with a PO acknowledgement flow, but net-60 requires Finance sign-off. Kimberly — can you confirm if Net-45 is possible as a middle ground?

I attached a short marked-up doc (legal_markups_redline.docx) with exact edits. If Samantha is available, propose a 30-minute legal call Friday 10/19 at 09:00 PST to resolve the Term and Indemnity language.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Counsel, Contracting
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-2045
